prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Mamta didi, Subhash bhai, Prakash bhai, Subhash N..
The chat covers 14/04/26, 8:30 pm to 14/04/26, 10:30 pm. It must have exactly 22 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
14/04/26, 9:39 pm - Subhash bhai: Prakash bhai, ye entry abhi delete kar do, kisi ko mat batana
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
text:
14/04/26, 8:30 pm - Mamta didi: Haal chaal batao sab, aaj shaam ki UPI reconciliation report ready hai kya?
14/04/26, 8:35 pm - Prakash bhai: Haan Mamta didi, main system me saari entries check kar raha hu.
14/04/26, 8:41 pm - Subhash N.: Aaj 50000 ka ek failed transaction show ho raha hai portal pe.
14/04/26, 8:46 pm - Subhash bhai: Subhash N. bro, wo customer care side se hold pe rakha hai, tension mat lo.
14/04/26, 8:52 pm - Mamta didi: Subhash bhai, standard procedure follow karna, audit me koi issue nahi hona chahiye.
14/04/26, 8:58 pm - Prakash bhai: Payment reference number mismatch dikha raha hai transaction ID 9821 me.
14/04/26, 9:05 pm - Subhash N.: Mismatch kyu aara? Customer ka claim hai balance deduct hua par credit nahi mila.
14/04/26, 9:11 pm - Subhash bhai: Wo QR scan duplicate tha lagta hai, main system log verify kar raha hu.
14/04/26, 9:18 pm - Mamta didi: Direct vendor account me transfer hua hai kya wo amount?
14/04/26, 9:24 pm - Subhash N.: Haan, suspicious personal UPI ID me divert hua lag raha hai.
14/04/26, 9:29 pm - Prakash bhai: Mujhe ledger me ek manually added entry mili hai abhi shaam 7 baje ki.
14/04/26, 9:33 pm - Subhash bhai: Prakash bhai private me baat karo 2 min, phone uthao.
14/04/26, 9:36 pm - Mamta didi: Main dinner ke liye ja rahi hu, 10 baje tak final summary sheet mail kar dena sab.
14/04/26, 9:37 pm - Subhash N.: Thik hai didi, main logs compile kar raha hu.
14/04/26, 9:39 pm - Subhash bhai: Prakash bhai, ye entry abhi delete kar do, kisi ko mat batana
14/04/26, 9:43 pm - Prakash bhai: Subhash bhai par ye audit trail me catch ho jayega, direct fraud case hai ye.
14/04/26, 9:50 pm - Subhash bhai: Kal subah settle kar denge cash me, bas abhi clear dikhna chahiye sheet me.
14/04/26, 9:58 pm - Subhash N.: Prakash bhai, server freeze kar rahe hain kya training simulation scenario ke liye?
14/04/26, 10:06 pm - Prakash bhai: Main flag raised status mark kar raha hu audit log me.
14/04/26, 10:14 pm - Mamta didi: Back post dinner. Subhash bhai, koi update mail nahi aaya abhi tak?
14/04/26, 10:22 pm - Subhash N.: Didi, manager dashboard par unauthorized entry detected flag ho gaya hai.
14/04/26, 10:30 pm - Subhash bhai: Simulation report ready hai, fraud scenario successfully completed.
